# External Datasets

No external datasets are required for this project. 
The benchmark dataset used is the self-contained 2,225 BBC News article corpus located in `data/raw/bbc-text.csv`.

**Reference Citation:**
Greene, D., & Cunningham, P. (2006). Practical Solutions to the Problem of Diagonal Dominance in Kernel Document Clustering. Proceedings of the 23rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML '06), pp. 377–384. [UCD Machine Learning Group](http://mlg.ucd.ie/datasets/bbc.html)
